No templates found with those criteria. Maybe need to include bonds broken/formed. The reaction breaks C-O bond and forms C-X (C-Br). Could search with bonds_broken=["C-O"], bonds_formed=["C-Br"]? Not sure format. The tool expects bond types like "6-6". Might not support element types. Could search without molecule_smiles? But required. Could try using the product molecule (with Br) as target, and functional_groups_broken maybe none. But we need template that when applied to product (with Br) gives precursors (with O-CH2CH3). Actually the template is for forward reaction (substitution). In retrosynthesis, we break C-Br to form C-O? Wait forward: OH -> Halogen. So retrosynthetic step: break C-X (halogen) to form C-O (alcohol). So functional_groups_broken in forward reaction: aliphatic hydroxyls (broken) and functional_groups_formed: alkyl halide. That's what we used. But maybe the template catalog uses "alkyl halide" as broken and "aliphatic hydroxyls" as formed for retrosynthesis? Actually forward reaction: OH broken, halide formed. So our criteria correct.

But maybe need to include bonds_broken ["C-O"] and bonds_formed ["C-X"]? Not sure.

Alternative: search without criteria just by molecule to get applicable templates, then filter manually. Let's search with only molecule_smiles and limit maybe 20.
